description:
Descripción de la empresa Za&Za Dancewear es una empresa dedicada al diseño y creación de ropa de danza moderna y de alta calidad. Nos enfocamos en ofrecer prendas funcionales y con estilo para bailarines de distintos niveles y disciplinas. Valoramos la creatividad, la innovación y la conexión con la comunidad de la danza. Trabajar con Za&Za Dancewear significa formar parte de un entorno dinámico donde se combinan moda, arte y movimiento. Buscamos personas con ganas de aprender y aportar ideas frescas a nuestra presencia digital.

Descripción del puesto Como CONTENT & SOCIAL MEDIA INTERN en Za&Za Dancewear, te encargarás del apoyo diario en la creación, edición y publicación de contenidos para redes sociales y web. Colaborarás en la planificación de la estrategia de contenidos, elaboración de copys para posts, stories y newsletters, así como en la gestión básica del calendario editorial. Ayudarás a mantener actualizada la web con textos atractivos y alineados con la identidad de la marca, y participarás en el seguimiento de métricas básicas de rendimiento de contenidos. Este es un puesto de prácticas (internship) o freelance en modalidad híbrida: el puesto está ubicado en Monterrey/ Puebla, y parte del trabajo se puede realizar desde casa. Podrás colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de marketing y aportar tus ideas para mejorar la presencia digital de la empresa.

Requisitos

Aptitudes sólidas de comunicación, tanto escrita como verbal, y capacidad para adaptar el mensaje a diferentes públicos y canales.
Aptitudes en redacción de contenido web y escritura creativa (web content writing, writing) orientadas a captar la atención y reflejar el tono de la marca.
Conocimientos básicos de estrategia de contenidos (content strategy) y nociones de branding digital para redes sociales.
Capacidad para apoyar en la gestión de contenidos (content management), organización de materiales y mantenimiento de un calendario editorial.
Interés por la danza, la moda o el ámbito creativo, actitud proactiva, ganas de aprender, manejo básico de herramientas de redes sociales y edición de imagen/vídeo será muy valorado.

Marketing Coordinator

Location: Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico | Regional Scope: Mexico, Colombia, Argentina & Chile

About The Position

Are you passionate about marketing, creativity, and making a real business impact?

At goFLUENT, we believe that communication has the power to transform organizations. As a global leader in corporate language training, we help thousands of companies worldwide develop their employees' language skills through innovative technology, AI-powered learning solutions, and human interaction.

We are looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven Marketing Coordinator to join our regional team, based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico, and support our growing business across four key Latin American markets: Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, and Chile.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the growth of an established international company, strengthen our brand presence across Latin America, and work closely with regional Sales teams and global Marketing colleagues.

You will play an important role in developing and executing regional marketing initiatives, creating engaging content, supporting lead generation strategies, and bringing our brand closer to business audiences across different markets.

You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries, gain international exposure, and contribute directly to our regional business growth.

What You'll Do


Drive regional brand awareness: Develop and coordinate marketing initiatives to strengthen goFLUENT's brand positioning and visibility across Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, and Chile.
Support regional business growth: Partner with local Sales teams across the four markets to plan and execute marketing campaigns, activities, and initiatives that support commercial objectives.
Coordinate global and regional marketing initiatives: Work closely with international Marketing colleagues to adapt and implement global campaigns according to local market needs and business priorities.
Create engaging content: Develop and coordinate social media posts, articles, newsletters, press releases, and other marketing materials tailored to regional audiences.
Manage digital channels: Support and grow our social media presence, ensuring consistent brand communication and audience engagement across markets.
Organize events and webinars: Coordinate online and in-person events, webinars, and activities with clients, prospects, and strategic partners across the region.
Support lead generation: Execute marketing initiatives to attract potential customers, generate qualified leads, and contribute to the regional sales pipeline.
Analyze campaign performance: Monitor marketing activities, prepare reports, track KPIs, and identify opportunities for improvement across different markets.
Support sales enablement: Assist with the creation and adaptation of commercial presentations, marketing materials, and other resources for regional Sales teams.
Contribute to customer marketing: Support customer engagement initiatives, marketing pilots, user registrations, and campaign follow-ups.


You'll Love This Job If You


Have 2–3 years of experience in Marketing, preferably in B2B environments.
Have a genuine interest in B2B marketing, digital communication, brand positioning, and demand generation.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.
Enjoy creating content and adapting communication strategies to different audiences and markets.
Have experience managing social media platforms and coordinating marketing campaigns.
Are familiar with digital marketing tools, CRM platforms, and marketing automation systems. Knowledge of Salesforce or Marketing Cloud is a plus.
Are comfortable working with data, tracking KPIs, and preparing performance reports.
Are highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Enjoy collaborating with different teams and working in an international, multicultural environment.
Have a creative mindset and a hands-on approach to getting things done.
Are comfortable coordinating initiatives across different countries and working with multicultural teams.


Why Join goFLUENT?


Become part of an established international company with a strong global presence.
Work with multicultural teams across Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, and Chile.
Gain regional and international exposure by collaborating with different business units and global stakeholders.
Contribute to meaningful marketing projects with direct business impact.
Develop your marketing skills in a dynamic and technology-driven industry.
Enjoy opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
Be part of a company that values innovation, collaboration, and people development.


Ready to make an impact?

Join goFLUENT and help us connect people, businesses, and opportunities through better communication!

goFLUENT, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, is the world’s leading B2B provider of hyper-personalized solutions that accelerate language skills by blending technology, content and virtual human interaction on any device.

description:
We are looking for a modern Media & Digital leader, who deeply understands how media, social platforms, content and creators work together to build brands and drive business results. The Media & Digital manager manager is responsible for managing digital and media ecosystems for Heinz Brand in its 2 priority categories Tomato Ketchup & Mayonnaise. Beyond strong media strategy and planning expertise, this person should have hands-on experience in content creation, social ecosystems, influencer marketing and emerging digital formats, bringing a fresh perspective on how brands connect with consumers in today's media landscape. In terms of marketing performance, maximizing ROI remains one of the most important priorities of the role. This role will own the annual media planning, day-to-day management of media plan and resources & digital ecosystem management. Lead and influence work with global media team & local & global media agency partners, media vendors & content creators to deliver winning & optimized media plans that deliver the best ROI & strengthen brand power. Over time, this leader will play a key role in helping Heinz build and manage future in-house digital and content capabilities.

Job Description

Key Activities/ Deliverables: 


1. Translate brand objectives into integrated media and digital strategies


Define audience, channel, content and investment priorities based on brand JTBDs, ensuring a consistent and compelling brand presence across all consumer touchpoints.


2. Build social and content ecosystems that strengthen consumer connection


Develop social, content and influencer strategies that increase brand relevance, engagement and cultural connection with consumers.


3. Execute media investments with excellence and accountability


Ensure high-quality media deployment, strong agency management, timely activation and robust performance tracking across campaigns.


4. Maximize media effectiveness and ROI


Drive continuous optimization through testing, learning and performance measurement, ensuring investments generate the highest possible business impact.


5. Build future-ready digital marketing capabilities


Develop the talent, tools, partnerships and operating model required to establish world-class digital and content capabilities, including the future evolution toward an in-house agency model.

Competencies (experiences/ Education)


Advertising, media, content creation, digital production or agency ecosystem background, rather than a traditional FMCG/CPG marketing background.
10 years of experience in media strategy, media planning and digital marketing.

Fluent English

title: Senior Manager, CX Messaging and Activation Lead
skills: Segment by lifecycle stage rather than by org chart. Match messaging to where a colleague sits with a platform: one who has never heard of it needs a reason to care, one who tried it once and stopped needs a different reason to come back, and one who uses it weekly needs to know what changed.

Build divisional and cultural understanding into the work. Language, regulatory context, working norms, and attitudes toward AI at work differ across markets and business lines, and a message that reads as exciting in one place can read as overselling or as a threat in another. Partner with divisional and local communicators so messaging is adapted rather than translated.

Ground the WIIFM ("What’s In It For Me") in the colleague’s actual workday: the task that gets shorter, the handoff that stops breaking, the report nobody has to rebuild by hand. Avoid capability claims that do not name a job somebody is trying to get done.

Own the competitive frame. Position each platform against what colleagues are choosing instead, whether an external consumer AI tool, a manual workaround, or doing nothing, and make the honest case for the internal option rather than assuming the audience is captive.
Test messaging with real colleagues before it ships, in more than one division, and rewrite what does not land.
Keep the message library current as platforms change, and retire claims that stop being true.
Set the channel and audience strategy for each launch, deciding which channels to use and who to target, and own the resulting content end to end, creative through send.
Coordinate channel and audience decisions with the Peer Advocacy & Community Lead so broadcast and community messaging reinforce each other rather than duplicate or conflict.

Write the go-to-market plan for every major launch: target audience, messaging pillars in play, channel mix, sequencing, asset list, dates, and the adoption number the launch is meant to move. A launch is a plan on paper before it is a calendar invite.

Sequence the launch with the CX Training Lead and the Peer Advocacy & Community Lead so messaging, training readiness, and community activity land in the right order rather than competing on the same day.
Run a post-launch review after every Major launch: what the campaign moved, what it did not, and what changes in the next one. Feed the pattern back into the reusable launch approach.
Own the top of the funnel end to end, from unaware through interested to first use. Know the drop-off at each step, and fix the weakest step rather than adding more volume at the top.

Build the always-on layer that runs between launches so demand does not depend on a campaign being live: placement on the surfaces colleagues already hit, internal search and intranet presence, the platform site, and the moments new joiners are most open to trying something.
Establish the reusable launch playbook: message standards, frameworks, and templates that later launches and other teams run on.

Enable the people who carry the message. Equip stakeholders, champions, and divisional communicators with the positioning, proof points, and assets to make the case in their own words. This is sales enablement without a sales team.
Facilitate knowledge sharing through communication channels that connect colleagues with successful practices, lessons learned, and success stories.
Prepare colleagues for change by developing communication strategies that support adoption of new tools, workflows, and behaviors.

Partner closely with the Experience Architecture and Product teams to understand what each platform is and the CX strategy defined for it, so positioning and messaging stay grounded in the platform’s actual intent.
Feed user insights, friction points, and feature requests surfaced through campaigns and interviews back to the teams building and evolving each platform.

Own the legal, compliance, and regulatory review checkpoint for platform messaging, built into the launch timeline as a fast, repeatable step rather than a one-off cycle, so nothing overstates a platform’s capabilities, data handling, or compliance posture.
Know which platforms touch regulated, clinical, or personal data, and keep messaging current with internal policy on AI-related communications.
Write, design, and produce the core campaign assets, launch copy, short-form video, key visuals, on a real production cadence.

This is not a brief-an-agency-and-wait role; the person hired is expected to make the work themselves or partner internally with the design teams, especially in the early days of a launch when speed matters most.
Set quarterly targets for campaign metrics (click-throughs, video views, waitlist sign-ups), but treat none of them as the finish line.
Ensure every campaign metric ladders up to the platform’s two core success metrics, 30-day active use and the Sean Ellis test.
Partner with the Adoption Analytics & Insights Lead on the dashboard that shows that connection, not just the vanity numbers.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.

6–8+ years in product marketing, digital marketing, or brand strategy, with a highly creative portfolio. Product marketing for a software, SaaS, or platform product is the closest fit, whether the audience was external customers or internal users.
Experience owning top-of-funnel performance, including awareness-to-first-use conversion and diagnosing where an audience drops off.

The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer’s key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents.

The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to going above and beyonds, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion for Salesforce Marketing Cloud applications.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer.
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer’s implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
The CSM may be required for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.


Minimum Requirements


 +5 years work experience in one or more of the following: Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.Demonstrated expertise of 2+ years within the Salesforce Ecosystem, specifically in Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud, including comprehensive knowledge of its product features, capabilities, optimal use cases, and strategic deployment.
 Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
 Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
 Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies
 Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects
 Available for a flexible schedule, 3 days in-office.


Preferred Requirements


Knowledge of Salesforce Core products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy are a plus.Salesforce Certifications (Salesforce Certified Platform Foundations, Salesforce Certified Platform AdministratorCloud Admin, Marketing Cloud Consultant or similar)
Knowledge and certifications in Data Cloud and Agentforce.

Acting as a trusted commercial advisor, you will deeply understand your customers' business needs, driving revenue expansion through upselling, cross-selling add-ons, and optimizing platform adoption. Your dedication to fostering strong, long-term relationships will directly reduce churn and contribute significantly to Deliverect's regional growth and ongoing market success.
 
This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Mexico City office and 2 days from the comfort of your home

3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS account management, customer success, or solutions consulting, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding expansion and retention targets. 
Demonstrable experience managing and nurturing relationships with mid-market preferably within the restaurant, food tech, or POS systems landscape.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a high degree of empathy and the ability to engage clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

A bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
Fluency in English is required, with strong written and verbal communication skills being essential.

Actively identify accounts at risk of churn, developing proactive retention strategies and handling objections with resilience to secure long-term contract renewals.

Job Benefits

Join Our Innovative Journey:

At Deliverect, we're not just building a platform; we're redefining how restaurants and retailers connect with their customers globally. We're looking for agile, ambitious, and resourceful team members who are excited to tackle complex challenges, take calculated risks and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of commerce.

Collaborate with a Global Team- Be part of a diverse, international team that values transparency, visibility, and a multitude of perspectives.
Be Part of a Unicorn- Join a rapidly scaling SaaS unicorn at the forefront of the order management industry, where your contributions have significant impact.

Ampliarás la narrativa de la marca e interactuarás con nuestra ya próspera comunidad y la desarrollarás en un ecosistema social de clase mundial.

Sobre la posición




Estarás estrechamente integrado con el equipo de marketing responsable de la publicidad, la marca y otros contenidos y te centrarás en crear e implementar la identidad de nuestros lugares en medios gráficos digitales e impresos. •⁠ ⁠Engagement en comentarios y fotos etiquetadas.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de gestión de proyectos como Asana, monday.com, Trello, etc.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia en arte y lujo es un plus.

•⁠ ⁠Excelentes habilidades de escritura con gran atención a los detalles, la gramática y el tono.

title: Associate Manager, Marketing
skills: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Communications, or a related field.
Educational background from recognized academic institutions (e.g., ITAM, Tecnológico de Monterrey, Universidad Iberoamericana, or equivalent) is preferred.
Upper-intermediate to advanced English proficiency is required, including the ability to communicate effectively with international teams, franchisees, agencies, and corporate stakeholders.
3+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing coordination, business administration, project management, financial tracking, or business analytics.
Previous experience supporting regional marketing teams, senior executives, or multiple business units is highly desirable.
Experience in FMCG, retail, QSR, hospitality, or the restaurant industry is preferred.
Demonstrated experience managing budgets, vendor invoices, administrative processes, and marketing project trackers.
Experience consolidating business data, preparing performance reports, and developing executive presentations.
Familiarity with marketing campaigns, digital media, and agency coordination.
Experience working with cross-functional and international teams in a corporate or franchise business environment is an advantage.
Marketing Budget & Financial Administration
Maintain and update marketing budget trackers for Applebee’s and IHOP across Canada, LATAM, and the Caribbean.
Monitor approved budgets, actual expenditures, commitments, and budget variances.
Track franchisee marketing contributions, Brand Advertising Fund (BAF) allocations, and related financial documentation.
Coordinate vendor invoice processing, approvals, payment status, and follow-up with Finance and Accounts Payable.
Support monthly financial reconciliations, accruals, expense coding, and budget reporting.
Consolidate financial information for monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing reviews.
Maintain accurate and organized records of marketing expenditures, invoices, contracts, and supporting documentation.
Identify pending payments, discrepancies, and administrative issues, proactively coordinating their resolution.
Vendor & Agency Coordination
Serve as an operational point of contact for recurring administrative matters involving marketing agencies, vendors, and external partners.
Coordinate vendor onboarding documentation, purchase requests, approvals, and payment follow-up.
Maintain updated agency scopes of work, contracts, deliverable trackers, and supporting documentation.
Monitor project deadlines, pending deliverables, and outstanding requests from agencies and suppliers.
Organize recurring agency meetings, document action items, and follow up on agreed next steps.
Support communication and coordination between agencies, internal marketing teams, and regional stakeholders.
Ensure that administrative processes and documentation are completed accurately and on time.
Marketing Project Management & Coordination
Maintain centralized marketing project trackers for both brands across Canada, LATAM, and the Caribbean.
Monitor project status, deadlines, deliverables, responsibilities, and pending approvals.
Coordinate project timelines and follow up with internal teams, agencies, and franchisees to ensure timely completion.
Organize meetings, prepare agendas, document minutes, and maintain action-item trackers.
Support the coordination of marketing calendars, campaign milestones, product launches, and regional initiatives.
Maintain shared project documentation, marketing materials, and organized digital files.
Identify potential delays, operational bottlenecks, or missing information and proactively escalate issues when necessary.
Help ensure visibility and alignment across multiple markets, brands, and functional teams.
Business Analytics & Performance Reporting
Consolidate recurring business performance information, including restaurant sales, guest traffic, average check, product mix, and promotional performance.
Maintain updated reporting trackers, marketing scorecards, and performance dashboards.
Support monthly and quarterly analysis of marketing initiatives and business results.
Analyze campaign performance and identify trends, opportunities, and potential areas of concern.
Prepare comparisons across markets, franchisee groups, restaurants, and promotional periods.
Support the evaluation of marketing investment effectiveness, including media performance and return on investment.
Translate business data into clear, relevant, and actionable insights that support management decisions.
Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely availability of information used in regional business reviews.
Executive Reporting & Presentation Support
Support the preparation of Business Reviews, franchisee presentations, leadership meetings, and regional marketing updates.
Consolidate information from multiple sources and stakeholders into clear, structured presentations.
Update charts, tables, scorecards, financial information, and supporting materials.
Prepare recurring executive reports summarizing business performance, project progress, marketing activities, and budget status.
Ensure consistency in presentation formatting, data accuracy, and documentation.
Coordinate the collection of required information from Finance, Operations, Marketing, agencies, and franchisee teams.
Maintain updated versions of key presentations and reporting documents.
Digital Marketing & Delivery Coordination
Provide operational support for digital marketing initiatives across both brands, working in coordination with agencies and regional marketing teams.
Monitor campaign calendars, implementation timelines, approvals, and pending deliverables.
Consolidate digital campaign performance metrics and agency reports.
Support the tracking of media investment, campaign results, and optimization recommendations.
Assist with the coordination of delivery-related marketing initiatives when required.
Support the collection and analysis of performance information from third-party delivery platforms, including Uber Eats, Rappi, and DiDi, where applicable.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting, coordination, and operational efficiency across digital and delivery initiatives.
Cross-Functional & Franchisee Coordination
Support ongoing communication and administrative coordination with franchisee groups across Canada, LATAM, and the Caribbean.
Coordinate the distribution of approved marketing calendars, materials, guidelines, and relevant communications.
Follow up on information requests, project deliverables, and administrative requirements involving franchisees.
Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Procurement, Training, and other corporate functions.
Support the coordination of regional initiatives requiring participation from multiple teams or markets.
Maintain organized records of franchisee requests, pending actions, and follow-up activities.
Help ensure timely communication, accountability, and consistent execution across the region.

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Social Senior Specialist, you will build, launch, and improve Paid Social campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, Reddit) to grow new customers, revenue, and LTV while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll follow clear playbooks, turn performance data and creative learnings into next actions, and pilot practical innovations at a small scale before wider rollout. You’ll work closely with Creative, Analytics, Product/Bliss Point, and senior channel leads in your Pod, communicate clearly with clients, and document what works so the team can reuse it. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Prepare on‑time, accurate updates and contribute to QBR inputs; explain results and recommended next steps in plain language tied to goals.
Take action on client requests (e.g., promo changes, budgets) within guardrails and escalate when trade‑offs are needed.


The Tinuiti Way


Own day-to-day campaign management across Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, etc)
Apply strong Paid Social craft aligned with the Tinuiti Way (creative + audience + signal quality) with growing multi‑channel awareness; share simple “how‑to” guides and playbacks for repeatability.


Product‑Led


Operate platform features (Meta Advantage+/value optimization/CAPI, TikTok Smart Performance, Pinterest Performance+); run small, safe pilots and monitor outcomes before scaling.
Use Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) shared by the team to guide day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback for Product/Analytics.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; run basic A/Bs with predefined success criteria and simple read cadence; keep pacing and budgets healthy.
Maintain signal and data quality (pixel/CAPI basics, event checks, UTMs/GA4 alignment) using checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue and deliver on time; proactively reduce rework and non‑converting spend (e.g., creative fatigue, audience overlap, “learning limited”); close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.
Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own the result end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


3-5+ years running Paid Social with hands‑on builds, launches, pacing, and optimizations; strong experience on Meta and TikTok.
Confidence planning and executing across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, and Reddit; familiarity with LinkedIn and X is a plus.
Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics; can turn data into clear next steps and basic forecasts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear client‑facing updates; cross‑functional teamwork; ability to mentor and delegate work to more junior team members.
Advanced Excel/Sheets and presentation tool skills


KPIs 


Growth: Increase qualified reach and new‑customer acquisition; contribute to revenue and LTV growth from Paid Social.
Creative: Faster creative innovation cycles and higher win rate; reduced fatigue.
Audience and signal: Expand high‑intent audiences; improve pixel/CAPI/event health; fewer “limited learning” cases.
Innovation: Deliver a steady flow of practical innovations (creative, audience, bidding, format) and record decisions and learnings.
Product/AI adoption: Pilot and adopt platform automation and Bliss Point‑guided optimizations with proven, incremental impact.
Efficiency (guardrail): Maintain or improve CAC/ROAS while growing profitable volume.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Perks and Wellness: Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

description:
Who are we?

Incubeta is an AI-powered, end-to-end marketing agency helping ambitious brands use marketing as a driver of sustainable growth and long-term business success.

Operating across 18 countries, we connect media, creative, data and technology through our proprietary Seamless approach, helping brands navigate an increasingly complex marketing landscape and deliver measurable business impact.

At Incubeta, we value an entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement. We believe our people are at the heart of our success and encourage everyone to challenge conventional thinking and bring new ideas to the table.

About The Role

This is a hands-on consulting position that combines deep technical platform expertise with client advisory skills.

You will serve as a key specialist in Search Ads 360 (SA360), leading implementations, account optimization, bidding strategies, and conversion tracking while supporting broader Google Marketing Platform (GMP) solutions, including Campaign Manager 360 (CM360), Google Ads, and Microsoft (Bing) Ads.

The ideal candidate is technically skilled, analytical, proactive, and comfortable translating complex platform concepts into actionable recommendations for clients.

Key Responsibilities


Lead SA360 account architecture, campaign structuring, bidding strategies, and ongoing optimization.
Configure and troubleshoot Floodlight activities, conversion tracking, and measurement solutions.
Manage and optimize integrations between SA360, Google Ads, and Microsoft (Bing) Ads.
Provide technical guidance on CM360 trafficking, tag implementation, attribution, and reporting.
Identify and resolve tracking discrepancies, conversion mismatches, and platform integration issues.
Support data integration workflows involving BigQuery, ETL processes, offline conversions, and feed automation.
Analyze campaign performance and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Collaborate with account management and strategy teams to identify optimization opportunities.
Act as a technical point of contact for complex GMP-related questions and troubleshooting.
Support internal training, onboarding, and documentation of SA360 and CM360 best practices.
Stay updated on GMP platform developments, product updates, and industry best practices.


What We're Looking For


Proven hands-on experience with Search Ads 360 (SA360), including campaign management, bid strategies, conversion tracking, and multi-engine account structures.
Working knowledge of Campaign Manager 360 (CM360), including Floodlight configuration, trafficking, tagging, and attribution.
Practical experience managing and optimizing campaigns in Google Ads and Microsoft (Bing) Ads.
Strong understanding of conversion measurement, troubleshooting, and campaign performance optimization.
Analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to improve campaign efficiency, conversion volume, and ROAS.
Experience working directly with clients or cross-functional teams and communicating technical concepts clearly.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
Ability to work collaboratively with international teams.


Nice to Have


Experience with Display & Video 360 (DV360) and programmatic advertising fundamentals.
Knowledge of BigQuery, ETL workflows, data warehouse integrations, and offline conversion imports.
Experience with feed automation and advanced measurement solutions.


What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help ensure that SA360 accounts are properly structured, conversion tracking is accurate, and bidding strategies are aligned with client objectives.

You will contribute to measurable performance improvements, reliable CM360 and Floodlight implementations, and stronger technical capabilities across the team.

What to do next?

If this sounds like the right next step for your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Ready to join the team? Click "Apply now" to get started.

Most new hires fall within the posted salary range, with opportunities to earn more over time based on individual and company performance. Initial offers are determined by several factors including relevant knowledge, skills, experience and location.

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana (formerly IRI and NPD) is the leading advisor on the complexity of consumer behavior. Through unparalleled technology, advanced analytics, cross-industry data, and deep expertise, we provide clarity that helps almost 7,000 of the world’s leading brands and retailers take action and unlock business growth. We understand more about the complete consumer, the complete store, and the complete wallet so our clients can go beyond the data to apply insights, ignite innovation, meet consumer demand, and outpace the competition.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities (with us you can always bring your full self to work). Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Learn more at www.circana.com.

What will you be doing? 

Our Media Delivery Analysts focus on providing comprehensive insights to our clients by analyzing the impact of digital and other media on shopping and purchasing patterns. Do you enjoy analyzing and interpreting media and digital data trends/patterns? Can you translate data into meaningful solutions for clients? Can you plan and focus your time to manage and deliver data extracts and reports? Can you work in a fast-paced environment? This position for you.

Job Responsibilities


Advanced Analytics Skills
Consistently analyzes and interprets data trends and patterns, and translate these into coherent insights, actions and recommendations creating client value. 
Familiarity with and the aptitude to apply statistical techniques to address business questions. 
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity of solutions and outcomes. 
Ad Operations Experience
Experience with pixels, log files, or other exposure data assets related to digital advertisement measurement. 
Experience communicating with DSPs/Ad Servers/Publishers in the digital marketing space as it relates to implementing pixels or receiving ad exposure log files. 
Planning and Organizing
Determines effort and resources required to meet objectives; plans, coordinates, and manages resources effectively. 
Has the foresight to identify possible issues and take action to mitigate them. 
Takes ownership of projects and holds oneself accountable to meet agreed upon timeline and quality standards. 
Must be able to effectively manage time and maintain focus in a highly charged environment, managing competing priorities against tight deadlines
Cross-Functional Influence
Demonstrates effective team behaviors including informing others of relevant information, supporting team decisions, encouraging others to share ideas, effectively resolving conflicts, and establishing common client focused goals. 
Adapts well to change and remains calm under pressure


Requirements


The successful candidate should have a bachelor’s degree. An advanced degree is a plus. 
Ideally, the applicant should have 2-4 years of work experience in media, with specific focus on digital and website analytics, Ad Tech, Ad Operations, Marketing Science, Marketing Mix Analysis, and/or Media Analytics. 
The candidate must also have experience providing analytical solutions and business insights to create value for clients or executive level management. 
Familiarity with the CPG and/or GM industries
Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft applications
Familiarity with research studies (test/control, AB testing, mix modeling)


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect and integrity
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone


Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Associate who will:


Interact effectively with regional teams and be a strong communicator.   
Support digital media campaign launches and setup according to established processes.   
Monitor and report on digital media campaign checks across channels/platforms.   
Ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP Media campaign management software.   
Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting and providing commentary to regional teams.  


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 
Excellent communication, both written and verbal. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Already using AI software and create ways to make things efficient
Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets with a strong understanding of its capabilities and limitations relative to Excel
Demonstrated hands-on experience reporting across Google Ads and Microsoft/Bing Ads (required); experience with Apple Search Ads (ASA) and UAC/App campaigns (required)
Strong understanding of YouTube campaign metrics, including view-through attribution and the distinction between brand and direct response KPIs
Solid understanding of tracking and attribution infrastructure including UTM parameters, conversion tags, pixels, and how data flows from platform to reporting tool
Proven ability to QA data flows, troubleshoot discrepancies, and identify root causes across complex multi-platform reporting environments
Demonstrated ability to identify issues proactively and communicate them with clarity, context, and a recommended path forward
Strong understanding of pacing and budget management with experience flagging and resolving delivery issues across multiple campaigns simultaneously
Experience working with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar BI platforms is a plus
Exceptional attention to detail; takes full ownership of data accuracy and never publishes unreviewed work
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex data issues simply and professionally
Highly organized, responsive, and able to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

As Product Manager - Immunology, you will lead the commercial strategy and life-cycle management for assigned Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease products within the Immunology portfolio. The role is responsible for developing and executing product strategies that deliver sales and margin targets, accelerate market access, and ensure sustainable competitive positioning. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate clinical and market insights into actionable plans.

Key Responsibilities

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


Brand strategy: Own the end-to-end brand strategy for Immunology and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease products, including the launch of a new indication. Develop and implement the Brand Plan and Long-Range Plan, covering commercial and demand planning, forecasting, resource allocation, risk and opportunity identification, and Advertising and Promotion budget management. Monitor product performance through quantitative and qualitative metrics, identify gaps, and lead corrective action plans to improve outcomes.
Market analysis: Conduct market analyses using audits, primary and secondary research, and field intelligence to identify pain points and unmet needs among clinicians, patients, payers, and healthcare administrators. Convert findings into actionable commercial insights.
Segmentation and positioning: Develop patient journeys, healthcare professional behavioural segmentation, customer targeting, and omnichannel strategies. Identify barriers to patient identification, diagnosis, referral, and treatment initiation. Translate market insights and clinical evidence into clear positioning, differentiated value propositions, messages, campaigns, and integrated customer engagement plans.
Strategy execution: Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, business cases, and implementation plans with measurable objectives and key performance indicators. Drive field execution by partnering with, coaching, and aligning the sales force to support the correct implementation of the strategy, timely tactical adjustments, and effective field engagement.
Market access: Accelerate private- and public-sector market access in collaboration with the Market Access, Regulatory, and Health Economics and Outcomes Research teams.
Cross-functional enablement: Ensure strategic alignment across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Sales, Regulatory, Finance, and other enabling functions. Resolve dependencies and drive timely decisions through cross-functional influence, without relying on formal authority.


Why You?

Basic Qualifications

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals


Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
Solid experience managing pharmaceutical brands or portfolios as a Product Manager, including high-specialty or high-cost products within complex and competitive markets.
Strong commercial understanding of market access, with experience partnering across institutional, public, and private healthcare channels.
Expertise in demand forecasting, market analysis, customer segmentation, brand positioning, and end-to-end strategy execution.
Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to operate effectively in regional and global business environments.
Strategic and analytical leadership capabilities, with a strong track record of influencing cross-functional stakeholders and translating insights into measurable business results.


Preferred Qualifications

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


Experience in respiratory medicine, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease products, or a related therapeutic area.
Experience leading multi-product portfolio strategies for biologics and/or newly launched indications, with a track record of accelerating post-launch uptake.
People-management experience or demonstrated potential to lead and develop.


Working Model and Location

This role offers a To confirm working model and may be based in To confirm, Mexico, combining To confirm as business needs require.

How To Apply

Please submit your updated résumé and ensure it clearly specifies the therapeutic areas in which you have experience.

Skills

Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Marketing Campaign Planning, Marketing Measurement, Marketing Strategy Implementation, Omnichannel Marketing, Scientific Literacy

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Manager, CX Adoption
skills: Run each beta or pilot end to end once the Adoption Lead and Product have set its scope and success criteria: cohort recruitment and onboarding, mission protocol, participant guide, comms cadence and close-out.

Keep the cohort engaged for the length of the program: run the kickoff and check-in sessions, create the shared channel where participants compare notes, spot drop-off early and intervene before it spreads, and raise blockers to Product while there is still time to fix them.

Capture participant behavior and feedback across platform data, surveys and sessions, and deliver a plain-language readout with a recommendation on what to fix, what to keep and whether the platform is ready for wider release.
Maintain the group's beta and pilot playbook (templates, timelines, checklists) and improve it after every program so each new one starts from the last.
Carry beta and pilot learnings into the launch plan: the messages that landed, the stalls to design around and the colleague stories worth telling.

Deliver assigned launch and campaign workstreams led by the Messaging and Activation Lead: draft colleague-facing messages, Teams posts and in-product prompts within the positioning and messaging guidelines set by Comms and Product, tailor them to the business units and teams being activated, and test hooks, timing and format.
Track colleague exposure across the eight platforms, flag where betas, launches and campaigns would collide, and recommend sequencing to the Adoption Lead.

Produce short-form learning assets (quick-start guides, walkthroughs, mission-style challenges) that move colleagues from first use to habit, and measure them by behavior change in the product rather than completion.

Run post-launch follow-through on assigned platforms at the team level: team onboarding sessions, use-case spotlights from inside the group, re-engagement of colleagues who tried once and stopped, and nudges timed to the moments a team is most likely to form a habit.

Feed the group's adoption metrics from every program this role runs: participation, activation, 30-day active use and sentiment for each cohort, business unit and team, reported on the cadence the Analytics & Insights Lead sets so the picture is never out of date.

Use those metrics to choose the next action: read where a cohort or team is stalling in the funnel and adjust the program while it is running, whether that means a new mission, a different message, a team session or a direct follow-up with the people who stopped.

Help recruit, onboard and maintain the Enterprise Colleague Advisory Community panel as the primary source of beta and pilot participants, keeping it representative across business units and within contact caps so colleagues are not over-asked.

Help build and run the communities of practice and champion groups that keep adoption going after launch: recurring sessions, shared channels and peer-to-peer problem solving, in coordination with the Experiences, Engagement and Enablement team so in-person events connect to live programs.
Collect colleague stories, quotes and use cases from these groups for comms, training and leadership materials.

Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 4 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 2 years of experience; OR a PhD with 0+ years of experience; OR an associate's degree with at least 8 years of experience; OR a high school diploma, or equivalent, with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

Relevant experience is in product adoption, internal communications, change management, digital learning, program coordination or a related field. Experience delivering pilots, betas, early-access or cross-functional programs end to end within a defined plan, from participant recruitment through measurement and close-out, and carrying the results into a wider launch.
Experience engaging groups of users or colleagues over time: facilitating sessions, running cohorts or communities, and keeping participation up across a program rather than a single event.
Hands-on content production: able to write, build and ship participant and colleague-facing assets without an agency.
Working fluency with usage and engagement data: able to read a funnel, build a simple dashboard view and explain what it means to non-analysts.
Clear, plain written and spoken English; able to present findings and recommendations to managers and directors.
Able to manage several concurrent workstreams and reprioritize as program timelines change.
Daily user of generative AI tools in own work.

Ran a beta, early-access or pilot program for an enterprise software or AI product, including participant recruitment, mission or task design, and analysis of what participants actually did in the product.
Experience driving adoption of enterprise AI tools (for example Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude) inside a large, matrixed organization, with evidence of what moved usage.

Experience recruiting and maintaining a research or advisory panel, champion network or community of practice: keeping it representative, managing contact frequency and sustaining participation over time.
Applied knowledge of behavioral science or lifecycle marketing as it relates to habit formation: onboarding sequences, triggers, nudges and re-engagement of lapsed users.
Comfort building lightweight tools, trackers or prototypes with AI-assisted development to support program delivery.
Pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience.
The annual base salary for this position in Tampa, FL ranges from $89,400.00 to $149,000.00.
description:
What You Will Achieve

The Manager, CX Adoption sits in the Adoption group within Customer Experience & Adoption, which exists to close the gap between capability built and practice adopted across Pfizer's internal AI platforms, used by roughly 80,000 colleagues. The role delivers adoption work across the full cycle: from the first beta or pilot, through launch and the campaigns that follow, to the training and community work that turns first use into habit. Betas and pilots are the main focus; once a platform is live, the same hands-on support continues through the rest of the cycle. Throughout, the unit of work is a group of colleagues rather than an individual: pilot cohorts, business units, functional teams and communities of practice that adopt together and keep each other going.

Working within the strategy and program design set by the Adoption Lead and the discipline Leads (messaging and activation, analytics and insights, training and gamification, advocacy and community), the Manager runs each beta or pilot from recruitment through close-out, then carries what was learned into the launch plan and the Embed-stage work that follows. The role recommends; the Adoption Lead and Product decide.

This is a hands-on execution role that works across all four adoption disciplines rather than owning any one of them. The Manager drafts, builds, tests and measures directly, applying the Adoption group's established methods, its funnel (Attract, Ignite, Embed) and its anchor metrics: 30-day active use and the share of colleagues who would be very disappointed if a platform went away.

How You Will Achieve It

Beta and pilot delivery (primary focus)


Run each beta or pilot end to end once the Adoption Lead and Product have set its scope and success criteria: cohort recruitment and onboarding, mission protocol, participant guide, comms cadence and close-out. 
Keep the cohort engaged for the length of the program: run the kickoff and check-in sessions, create the shared channel where participants compare notes, spot drop-off early and intervene before it spreads, and raise blockers to Product while there is still time to fix them. 
Capture participant behavior and feedback across platform data, surveys and sessions, and deliver a plain-language readout with a recommendation on what to fix, what to keep and whether the platform is ready for wider release. 
Maintain the group's beta and pilot playbook (templates, timelines, checklists) and improve it after every program so each new one starts from the last. 


Launch and activation (Attract and Ignite)


Carry beta and pilot learnings into the launch plan: the messages that landed, the stalls to design around and the colleague stories worth telling. 
Deliver assigned launch and campaign workstreams led by the Messaging and Activation Lead: draft colleague-facing messages, Teams posts and in-product prompts within the positioning and messaging guidelines set by Comms and Product, tailor them to the business units and teams being activated, and test hooks, timing and format. 
Track colleague exposure across the eight platforms, flag where betas, launches and campaigns would collide, and recommend sequencing to the Adoption Lead. 


Sustained use (Embed)


Produce short-form learning assets (quick-start guides, walkthroughs, mission-style challenges) that move colleagues from first use to habit, and measure them by behavior change in the product rather than completion. 
Run post-launch follow-through on assigned platforms at the team level: team onboarding sessions, use-case spotlights from inside the group, re-engagement of colleagues who tried once and stopped, and nudges timed to the moments a team is most likely to form a habit. 


Measurement and insight


Feed the group's adoption metrics from every program this role runs: participation, activation, 30-day active use and sentiment for each cohort, business unit and team, reported on the cadence the Analytics & Insights Lead sets so the picture is never out of date. 
Use those metrics to choose the next action: read where a cohort or team is stalling in the funnel and adjust the program while it is running, whether that means a new mission, a different message, a team session or a direct follow-up with the people who stopped. 


Advocacy and community


Help recruit, onboard and maintain the Enterprise Colleague Advisory Community panel as the primary source of beta and pilot participants, keeping it representative across business units and within contact caps so colleagues are not over-asked. 
Help build and run the communities of practice and champion groups that keep adoption going after launch: recurring sessions, shared channels and peer-to-peer problem solving, in coordination with the Experiences, Engagement and Enablement team so in-person events connect to live programs. 
Collect colleague stories, quotes and use cases from these groups for comms, training and leadership materials. 


Here Is What You Need (Basic Requirements)


Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 4 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 2 years of experience; OR a PhD with 0+ years of experience; OR an associate's degree with at least 8 years of experience; OR a high school diploma, or equivalent, with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

description:
About Birdman



At Birdman, we're on a mission to make plant-based nutrition more accessible and inspire people to embrace a healthier, more sustainable lifestyle.

We're a fast-growing company driven by innovation, collaboration, and a passion for challenging the status quo.

As we continue expanding our product portfolio and exploring new markets, we're preparing to open our new corporate offices in Mexico City, marking an exciting new chapter in Birdman's growth.

We're looking for a Consumer Insights & Innovation Manager to join our growing team and help turn consumer understanding into meaningful business opportunities.


About the Role



We're looking for a strategic, analytical, and results-driven professional who can connect consumer insights, market intelligence, and innovation to accelerate business growth.

In this role, you'll lead our consumer insights agenda and manage the end-to-end innovation pipeline, from identifying market opportunities and building business cases to coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring successful product launches.

You'll work closely with Marketing, R&D, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to turn data into actionable strategies and bring new ideas to market.

This is an opportunity to shape Birdman's innovation strategy, influence key business decisions, and drive impactful growth initiatives


What You'll Do

ES EL MOMENTO

Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo, la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar.

EL IMPACTO QUE GENERARÁS

Estamos buscando un/a ANALISTA DATA Y ESTRATEGIA DE MERCADO con base en CORPORATIVO REFORMA 490 CDMX.

Estamos redefiniendo nuestra forma de trabajar a través de la innovación, la tecnología de última generación, la colaboración y la libertad de explorar nuevas ideas.

Analizar tendencias de mercado, cartera, colocación, participación, precios y desempeño comercial, identificando desviaciones, oportunidades y hallazgos accionables. 
Documentar fuentes, reglas de negocio, controles, cambios y versiones de reportes en repositorios institucionales, manteniendo orden, trazabilidad y continuidad operativa. 
Traducir necesidades del negocio en requerimientos de información y colaborar con Data, Tecnología, Riesgos y Comercial en validaciones y entregables.

description:
Research and Data Analyst (Mexico)


 Contract Type: Full Time, Permanent 
 Salary: 500k MXN Annually ( inclusive of 13.5 months); 37k MXN Monthly 
 Benefits: Enjoy flexible work arrangements and an appreciation for work/life balance, as well as support for professional development and working with a multi-national team. 
 Location: Mexico City or Merida, Mexico, Remote 
 Reports to: Director of Research, based in Maine, USA 


Position Overview

Are you a life-long learner, curious about the world around you?

Are you ready to bring your unique skills to a mission-driven organization?

Do you enjoy digging into data, bringing trends and insights to life in a meaningful way to drive business decisions?

If so, we would love to welcome you to our global community!

We are looking for a Research and Data Analyst to help us collect data, analyze trends and patterns, and prepare compelling visual stories in support of strategic and operational decision-making.

IFSA (Institute for Study Abroad), a US-based nonprofit organization, creates global learning environments to help students gather the critical perspectives, knowledge, and skills essential for future success. With innovative programming and world-class support, IFSA delivers future-focused study abroad options in 19 countries and 48 cities around the globe. Our commitments to inclusive excellence , intercultural agility , individualized learning and enduring impact are present in every aspect of our programs.

Inclusion is a driving passion of our organization. We are committed to building a community where the thoughts and opinions of all team members are valued and contribute to our collective success, just as we build programs with the same focus. If you share our unwavering commitment to Inclusive Excellence and want to join a community that actively strives to improve in all that we do, IFSA is the place for you.

Learn more about IFSA at https://www.ifsa-butler.org/

In This Position, Your Responsibilities Would Include


 Providing critical and highly cyclical reporting based on lead, applicant, and enrollment analysis tailored for various internal stakeholders (i.e. student engagement, institutional engagement, marketing, regional directors). 
 Providing comprehensive analysis of survey data stored in Qualtrics, including visualization and presentation of findings to various key stakeholders at IFSA. This includes a wide range of audiences including student program participants, institutional partners, and internal IFSA staff. 
 Spearheading research on IFSA’s position in the marketplace by researching, analyzing and presenting findings on competitor products and services, locations, prices, sales and marketing methods. 
 Conducting study abroad market research, based on data on trends, developments, and opportunities related to international education. 
 Helping develop enrollment reports and dashboards in Salesforce, including potential integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI). 


Requirements, Work Experience And Education


 Bachelor’s degree required, Master's degree preferred ( i.e . Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Political Science, etc.) 
 Minimum of two to three years of progressive experience in strategic research and analysis 
 Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and data analysis required 
 Familiarity with various data analysis tools and techniques (i.e. Microsoft Office products, Qualtrics Research Suite, Salesforce) 
 Fluency in English, both oral and written, is required 
 Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sense of academic honesty 
 Ability to think critically and creatively, to show interest in (re)evaluating trends and opportunities 
 Demonstrated ability to multi-task, attend to multiple projects at once, meet deadlines 
 Ability to work independently but also as part of a dynamic and cohesive team 
 Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders from diverse communities and cultures   
 Authorized to work in and physically reside in Mexico 


We know there are great candidates who won’t check all of these boxes, and we also know you might bring important perspectives, experiences and skills that we haven’t considered. If this describes you, please don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself .

Physical and Work Environment


 Working on a computer, placing phone/video calls, updating systems and files. 
 Remote position . Laptop will be provided. 
 Potential for very limited international travel to the USA or other IFSA locations. 


To Apply

To apply, please submit your cover letter and resume for this position via IFSA’s career page: https://www.ifsa-butler.org/connect-with-us/ifsa-job-openings/

In your cover letter, offer a compelling “Why” statement as to your suitability to the role using the job responsibilities and organizational commitments as a framework, including your motivations for applying, and where you see your strengths complementing the role.

Review of applications will begin immediately, and the position will remain open until filled.  

IFSA is an equal opportunity employer, and our hiring process is inclusive of all genders and gender expressions, races and ethnicities, ages, religions and sexualities as well as veterans and people with disabilities.

skills: Develop and manage budgets and forecasts for Variable Marketing Expenses across all NMEX models.
Analyze incentive programs by model, comparing actual results against budget, forecast, and outlook.
Evaluate and approve commercial offers and incentive strategies by model and sales channel.
Perform month-end variance analysis of actual performance versus budget and prior year results.
Identify opportunities to improve profitability through optimization of incentive spending and WTO achievement.

Develop dashboards, reports, and performance analyses using Tableau and other reporting tools.
Support forecasting, reporting, and special projects for senior management.
Drive automation and process improvement initiatives within finance activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize commercial performance and resource utilization.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
At least 1 year of experience in a similar finance, analytics, or business support role.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and SAP.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to drive continuous improvement and process enhancement initiatives.
Customer-centric mindset with strong attention to detail.
Ability to influence and collaborate with teams without direct authority.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Results-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
English proficiency equivalent to 500 TOEIC points or higher.
3-5 years of experience in the Automotive Industry or Program Management within another industry.
Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience using Tableau, ThinkCell, and Power BI.

Experience creating dashboards and executive-level reports.

Experience working in cross-functional environments supporting Sales, Marketing, and Finance functions.
description:
Location(s): HQ, Mexico City (Local Candidates Only)

Job Schedule: Hybrid (4 Days Onsite / 1 Day Home Office)

Education Requirement: Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or related business field.

Sponsorship:

We are currently looking for a VME Analyst to join our team at HQ. This position will be responsible for controlling and analyzing Variable Marketing Expenses (VME), evaluating incentive strategies, commercial offers, and dealer incentive programs to support business profitability and sales performance.

The VME Analyst will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams to manage forecasts, budgets, and actual results, providing analytical insights that support decision-making and optimize resource allocation across Nissan's vehicle portfolio.
